name: Bleu de Chanel
description:
The Vibe: Timeless masculinity and effortless luxury.

The Scent Journey: A vibrant burst of fresh citrus and clean aromatic notes makes an immediate statement. The energy builds with a layer of crisp spices, melting into a sophisticated heart of warm amber and rich woods. A mysterious finish of subtle smoke and balsamic undertones leaves a smooth, powdery trail.

Best For: Classic gentlemen looking for a refined, confident daily signature.
